curated_rows.question: Where should visitors walk in Yellowstone's thermal areas, and how should children be supervised?
curated_rows.rendered:
Visitors should always walk on boardwalks and designated trails in Yellowstone's thermal areas. [Safety - Yellowstone National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yell/planyourvisit/safety.htm)

Children should be kept close and not allowed to run on boardwalks to ensure their safety. [Safety - Yellowstone National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yell/planyourvisit/safety.htm)

It is illegal and dangerous to enter or swim in thermal waters due to extreme heat and unique life forms. [Safety - Yellowstone National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yell/planyourvisit/safety.htm)

Pets are not allowed in thermal areas or on boardwalks to protect them from harm. [Safety - Yellowstone National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yell/planyourvisit/safety.htm)

Toxic gases may accumulate in some hydrothermal areas, so visitors should leave immediately if they feel sick. [Safety - Yellowstone National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/yell/planyourvisit/safety.htm)

curated_rows.question: Are ranger-led Grand Canyon South Rim day programs only a summer activity?

curated_rows.question: Then, for other Grand Canyon backcountry locations outside the three campgrounds with metal boxes, what must I bring to store food?
curated_rows.rendered:
Hikers must bring their own critter-proof food storage containers outside the three campgrounds. [Backcountry Food Storage - Grand Canyon National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/grca/planyourvisit/bc-food-storage.htm)

Metal cookie tins, bear canisters, and lockable cooking pots are sufficient alternatives. [Backcountry Food Storage - Grand Canyon National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/grca/planyourvisit/bc-food-storage.htm)

These containers are available for rent or purchase at Canyon Village Market on the South Rim. [Backcountry Food Storage - Grand Canyon National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/grca/planyourvisit/bc-food-storage.htm)

curated_rows.question: Can my ordinary soft backpack replace that container?
curated_rows.rendered:
Soft backpacks cannot substitute for animal-proof food storage containers. [Backcountry Food Storage - Grand Canyon National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/grca/planyourvisit/bc-food-storage.htm)

Leave all pockets and compartments of your backpack unzipped overnight to deter animals. [Backcountry Food Storage - Grand Canyon National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/grca/planyourvisit/bc-food-storage.htm)

Store all food and scented items in critter-proof containers, not just inside your pack. [Backcountry Food Storage - Grand Canyon National Park (U.S. National Park Service)](https://www.nps.gov/grca/planyourvisit/bc-food-storage.htm)

curated_rows.question: Can I use my drone for aerial photographs in Yellowstone?
